query:
SELECT
            date_trunc('hour', r.created_at)                    AS "bucket!: DateTime<Utc>",
            COUNT(*)                                            AS "count!: i64",
            SUM(COALESCE(rs.cached_score, 0.5)::double precision)
                                                                AS "weighted!: f64"
        FROM reports r
        LEFT JOIN reporter_stats rs ON rs.did = r.reporter_did
        WHERE r.created_at >= $1
        GROUP BY 1
        ORDER BY 1
